requirements.quote: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.

requirements.quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.

requirements.quote: However, in the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either: (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source); or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.

requirements.quote: Size: the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.

requirements.quote: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.

requirements.quote: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) The light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) A signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced. requirements.text: When the signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced, a note in the communication form shall state that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.quote: In this case a note in the communication form states that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.

requirements.text: When the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, a rear end-outline marker lamp category RM2 emitting more than the maximum value of category RM1, a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1, a stop lamp category S4 emitting more than the maximum value of category S3, a direction indicator of category 2b emitting more than the maximum value of category 2a, or a rear fog lamp of category F2 emitting more than the maximum value of category F1 fails, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of: (a) A rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1; (b) A rear end-outline marker lamp category RM2 emitting more than the maximum value of category RM1; (c) A stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1; (d) A stop lamp category S4 emitting more than the maximum value of category S3; (e) A direction indicator of category 2b emitting more than the maximum value of category 2a; (f) A rear fog lamp of category F2 emitting more than the maximum value of category F1. Requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with: replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).

requirements.text: When replaceable UN approved light source(s) are used, the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.quote: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), (a) The design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one;

requirements.text: When replaceable UN approved light source(s) are used, the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.
requirements.quote: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), (b) The light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.

requirements.text: When replaceable UN approved light source(s) are used, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed shall apply.
requirements.quote: The holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed, applies.

requirements.text: Where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s) shall apply.
requirements.quote: In addition, where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s) applies.

requirements.quote: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.

requirements.text: When replaceable light source module(s) are used, the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.quote: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that (a) it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s);

requirements.text: When replaceable light source module(s) are used, the design of the light source module(s) shall be tamperproof.

requirements.quote: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that (c) regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with: - any replaceable UN approved light source; and/or, - any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.

requirements.quote: (d) when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.

requirements.text: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the following conditions.
requirements.quote: General provisions All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the following conditions. (Particulars of the methods of measurement to be used are given in Annex 3):

requirements.text: When replaceable UN approved light sources are used, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
requirements.quote: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.

requirements.text: When a lamp is equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
requirements.quote: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.

requirements.text: When a lamp (function) uses light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.
requirements.quote: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.

requirements.text: All separate measurement results shall be added together.
requirements.quote: All separate measurement results shall be added together.

requirements.text: When the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In the case where the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The determination of the limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall not apply to rear-registration plate illuminating lamps.
requirements.quote: This requirement shall not apply to rear-registration plate illuminating lamps.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.quote: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).

requirements.text: When a lamp is not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.quote: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control: 4.8.2.2.1. in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant;

requirements.text: When a lamp is not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities.
requirements.quote: 4.8.2.2.2. in the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities;

requirements.quote: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources: 4.8.2.3.1. shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux of the light sources.

requirements.text: The measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux.
requirements.quote: The measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum, specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.

requirements.quote: Rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only:

requirements.text: If the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components, the rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular shall be installed on movable components only.
requirements.quote: If at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.

requirements.text: When the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D" (see paragraph 2.4.11.1.), only one of the lamps shall meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.
requirements.quote: In the case where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D" (see paragraph 2.4.11.1.), only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.

requirements.text: Where additional lamps for the above functions are fitted and are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, the additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.quote: Where additional lamps for the above functions are fitted and are switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.

requirements.text: When the complete interdependent lamp system is mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied, except that additional lamps for the above functions may be switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.quote: (a) Should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied. However, additional lamps for the above functions may be switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component;

requirements.text: When the interdependent lamp system is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: (b) Should the interdependent lamp system be partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: The inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) shall be deemed to be satisfied if this(these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: The inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) is(are) deemed to be satisfied if this(these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, photometric and colorimetric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s), except that where, to fulfil or complete the geometric visibility angle, additional lamps are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, the additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, photometric and colorimetric requirements applicable to the direction indicator lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.quote: For direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, photometric and colorimetric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s). This does not apply where, to fulfil or complete the geometric visibility angle, additional lamps are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, photometric and colorimetric requirements applicable to the direction indicator lamps installed on the movable component.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.quote: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".

requirements.text: If the above requirement is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component;

requirements.text: Where any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is used, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.quote: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.

requirements.text: Where any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is used, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
requirements.quote: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.

requirements.text: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.quote: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories the applicant shall demonstrate to the Technical Service responsible for type approval testing that the electric power supply conditions for the devices indicated in 2.5.1., 2.5.2., 2.5.4., 2.5.6. and 2.5.7. above comply, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, with the following provisions:
requirements.quote: For vehicles of M and N categories the applicant shall demonstrate to the Technical Service responsible for type approval testing that the electric power supply conditions for the devices indicated in 2.5.1., 2.5.2., 2.5.4., 2.5.6. and 2.5.7. above comply, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, with the following provisions:

requirements.text: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.quote: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.quote: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.

requirements.text: The devices which include: - an electronic light source control gear, or - a variable intensity control being part of the device, or - only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128 shall not be subject to the provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2.
requirements.quote: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include: - an electronic light source control gear, or - a variable intensity control being part of the device, or - only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.

requirements.text: The lamp shall have no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except that no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity. However, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.quote: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.

requirements.text: If the light-signalling lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: Especially in case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only, except for light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
requirements.quote: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only. This requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be present on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.
requirements.quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4. Optional on trailers of category O1.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be one device mandatory on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.
requirements.quote: One device mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamps shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: These devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground, except that for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.
requirements.quote: In height: not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground. For category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be at the rear of the vehicle, except that if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle However, if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp installed at the rear of the vehicle shall be defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
requirements.quote: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Rearwards

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.quote: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.
requirements.quote: It shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.

requirements.text: If required by the component regulation, the reversing lamp shall have a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.quote: Tell-tale Tell-tale optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.quote: Presence Devices of S1 or S2 categories: mandatory on all categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of S3 or S4 category shall be mandatory on M1 and N1 categories of vehicles, except for chassis-cabs and those N1 category vehicles with open cargo space.
requirements.quote: Devices of S3 or S4 category: mandatory on M1 and N1 categories of vehicles, except for chassis-cabs and those N1 category vehicles with open cargo space; optional on other categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall comprise two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.quote: Number Two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, the stop lamp of S1 or S2 categories that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle;

requirements.text: For all other categories of vehicles, the stop lamp of S1 or S2 categories shall be not less than 600 mm in the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm if the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: For S1 or S2 categories devices the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm if the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of S3 or S4 categories shall have the centre of reference situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 category devices: the centre of reference shall be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where the two stop lamps of the S3 or S4 category are installed according to paragraph 6.7.2., the stop lamps shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.
requirements.quote: However, in the case where the two devices of the S3 or S4 category are installed, according to paragraph 6.7.2., they shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.

requirements.text: Where one S3 or S4 category stop lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., this offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.
requirements.quote: In the case where one S3 or S4 category lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., this offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of S1 or S2 categories shall be above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm, except that 2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: Above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

requirements.text: If the optional lamps are installed, the stop lamps shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of S1 or S2 categories shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of S1 or S2 categories shall have a horizontal angle of 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, except that for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle. However, for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of S3 or S4 categories shall have a horizontal angle of 10° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 categories devices: 10° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle;

requirements.text: The stop lamp of S1 or S2 categories shall have a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) Where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of S3 or S4 categories shall have a vertical angle of 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 categories devices: 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Orientation Towards the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.quote: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.

requirements.text: If required by the component regulation, the stop lamp shall have a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.quote: Tell-tale optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: Number Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, except that this condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle. This condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.

requirements.text: Where the vehicle is not M1 and N1 category, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: have no special requirement; For all other categories of vehicles: be not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm, except that the maximum shall be 2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed.
requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

requirements.text: If the optional lamps are installed, the rear position lamps shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have horizontal angle 45° inwards and 80° outwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have vertical angle 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) Where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. above, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall have horizontal angle 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, Horizontal angle: 45° outwards to 45° inwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. above, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall have vertical angle 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres.
requirements.quote: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall exclude the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
requirements.quote: The illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Rearwards.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have electrical connections in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
requirements.quote: Electrical connections In accordance with paragraph 5.11.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a closed-circuit tell-tale.
requirements.quote: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp tell-tale shall be combined with that of the front position lamps, except that this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.quote: It shall be combined with that of the front position lamps. This requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: If required by the component Regulation, the rear position lamp shall have a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.quote: However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.quote: Number Two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall have that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For all other categories of vehicles, the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall have the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: have no special requirement; For all other categories of vehicles: be not less than 600 mm. regulations.rationale: This is the consolidated light-signalling device regulation covering rear position lamps, stop lamps and reversing lamps, all of which are specified functions of the product. (lexical: term match score 8.6)
The product includes a passive rear retro-reflector, which is a retro-reflective device covered by consolidated UN R150. (lexical: term match score 3.8)
The rear lamp contains electronics/LED modules on a PCB and is an electrical/electronic sub-assembly intended for M/N vehicles, so EMC requirements apply. (lexical: term match score 8.9)
When fitted to an M1 vehicle, the installation of rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and retro-reflectors is governed by UN R48. (lexical: term match score 20.2)
As an exterior part on an M1 passenger car, the outer lens/housing may need to satisfy external projection requirements when installed on the vehicle. (lexical: term match score 3.2)

The product includes a reversing lamp function, but UN R23 is the legacy regulation. The consolidated light-signalling device regulation UN R148 is preferred. (lexical: term match score 1.2; superseded by a consolidated regulation)

The product is a complete lamp with LED modules. UN R128 applies to separate standardized LED light sources, so it would apply only if such separate R128 light sources are used. (lexical: term match score 0.2)

The product uses LED modules, not filament light sources covered by UN R37. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
